spatialContract.trajectory: Sun-origin ECLIPJ2000 Cartesian kilometres sampled from NAIF SPICE SPK; event time labels UTC converted by NAIF LSK to ET/TDB
spatialContract.marsSurface: IAU Mars planetocentric latitude, positive-east longitude, degrees; surface heights not asserted
spatialContract.moonSurface: Mean Earth/Polar Axis, DE421, planetocentric latitude and positive-east longitude, degrees; NASA LRO image-derived locations
spatialContract.note: Surface longitude/latitude is body-fixed. It must not be treated as ECLIPJ2000 or drawn at a heliocentric position without a time-dependent PCK frame transform.

missions.name: Apollo 11
missions.summary: Humans reach the Sea of Tranquility. The descent stage and laser reflector remain on the Moon.
missions.trajectoryStatus: No spacecraft orbit line is shown until its flight vectors are ingested and validated. Planet and Moon positions come from SPICE.

missions.name: Viking 1
missions.summary: An orbiter surveys Mars; its lander settles on the western slopes of Chryse Planitia.
missions.trajectoryStatus: Viking 1 Orbiter's path comes from the NAIF reconstructed orbit SPK relative to the Mars-system barycenter. Cruise vectors are not yet ingested, so no Earth-to-Mars spacecraft arc is drawn.

objects.name: Viking Orbiter 1
objects.state: Historical Mars orbiter; no current orbit asserted

missions.name: Opportunity
missions.summary: A small rover crosses interplanetary space, lands in Eagle Crater, and begins a fourteen-year journey.
missions.trajectoryStatus: Cruise line comes from the archived MER1 SPICE spacecraft SPK. It stops at the last covered sample; it does not extrapolate into entry or surface travel.

objects.name: Opportunity rover
objects.state: Final known area: Perseverance Valley; no exact final point asserted
